samples.question: A token drops down this ladder from the black arrow: it slides down its vertical line, and at every horizontal rung it meets it crosses to the neighbouring line and keeps going down. The pale yellow band shows the route it takes in the ladder as drawn. The six slots along the bottom are numbered 1 to 6 from left to right. Exactly one rung is red; every other rung is blue. Take the red rung away, leave everything else unchanged, and drop the token again from the same arrow. Which slot does it reach? Answer with exactly one of: slot-1, slot-2, slot-3, slot-4, slot-5, slot-6.
